title: Rumeli Feneri
visualBrief: White three-stage octagonal masonry tower on its mapped eight-sided base, narrow staggered staircase windows, projecting zinc-colored stage caps, railed gallery, small clear lantern on tapering service drum, conical cap, tall four-legged external antenna cage, caged ladder, red radar array and exterior cable.

sourceFacts.basis: Coastal Safety Directorate publishes30m three-stage masonry tower and58m light elevation. Its opposed day/night and aerial photographs constrain stage proportions, white masonry, narrow stair windows, lantern and characteristic cage/antenna ensemble. OSMtower way1035459712 supplies the8.9x8.54m octagonal ground envelope; photographed stage proportions are13.5m combined lower tiers and11.3m upper shaft. Radar extension is photo-proportioned above the published tower height. OSM outlines are approximate map evidence, not an engineering survey. Mapped8.9x8.54m base is preserved without stretching; ordinary plinth/cornice overhangs remain outside it. Operator30m tower height is separate from58m light elevation. Radar/antenna33.8m top and individual tier heights/window allocation/hardware are photographic proportions. Operator-published equipment configuration is represented; completed restoration replacement equipment has not been independently documented. Adjacent keeper/tomb-front buildings, mosque and modern control tower are host map structures; tower interior/optic operation and exact inscriptions are omitted. No footprint replacement; host terrain supplies cliff height.

limitations: The modeled exterior follows the cited published facts and inspected photographs. Unpublished dimensions and local fittings are explicitly photo-proportioned; no claim of engineering survey accuracy is made.
Portable PBR and shared metric surfaces are provided. Surface weathering, material color under local lighting and fine facade relief require close render review before maximum-detail acceptance.

Source follows the operator-published tower exterior and antenna configuration. Ministry reports restoration activity but provides no verified completed replacement equipment configuration; temporary construction gear is omitted. Unpublished floor heights, windows, lantern hardware and tomb doorway trim are photograph-proportioned. Unresolved inscription text is not fabricated. Neighboring detached keeper/public buildings, mosque and modern control tower remain separate map structures.
